# 01 — Reverse-Engineering Analysis: OpenSEO (every-app/open-seo)

> Source analyzed: `https://github.com/every-app/open-seo` @ `46b815b` (v0.1.26, Nov 2026), cloned to `reference/open-seo/` (git-ignored, read-only reference).
> Method: static source analysis (directory inventory, Drizzle schemas, server functions, MCP tool registry, workflows, DataForSEO client, maintainer specs `docs/maintainers/specs/0001–0020`).
> Note: the REA MCP `analyze_javascript_application` tool was attempted on `src/`, `src/serverFunctions`, `src/server/workflows` and crashed each time (`unreadable_output` / `Connection closed`). All findings below come from direct source reading; file paths are cited so every claim can be re-verified.

---

## 1. What OpenSEO is

"Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs." A pay-as-you-go SEO suite whose **data comes almost entirely from DataForSEO** (a paid API). The hosted version (openseo.so) charges $10/mo + resells DataForSEO calls at +28% markup via "credits". Self-hosters bring their own DataForSEO key.

Differentiators it markets:
- First-class **MCP server** (~90 tools) + **Agent Skills** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, Hermes).
- Focused workflows, modern UI.
- In-app AI agent "**SAM**" (OpenRouter LLM).
- Self-hostable (Docker or Cloudflare).

**Key insight for us:** OpenSEO is not "free". Every core research feature (keywords, SERP, backlinks, domain overview, rank tracking, local grid, AI visibility, Lighthouse) is a metered DataForSEO call. Only the site-audit crawler, GSC, GA4, IndexNow, reports and project memory are truly free. Our product's core job is replacing the paid data layer with free/self-computed sources. See `05-free-data-sources.md`.

---

## 2. Tech stack (theirs)

| Layer | Tech |
|---|---|
| Framework | TanStack Start (React 19, SSR) + TanStack Router/Query/Form/Table/DB |
| Runtime | Cloudflare Workers (+ Workflows, Durable Objects, KV, R2, D1, Browser Rendering); Docker edition emulates workers via `workerd`/wrangler |
| DB | Drizzle ORM, dual dialect: SQLite/D1 and Postgres (schemas mirrored in `src/db/*.schema.ts` and `src/db/pg/*.schema.ts`) |
| Auth | Better Auth (email/password, Google OAuth, organizations, API keys), Cloudflare Access JWT, `local_noauth`, Every App gateway |
| MCP | `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` + `@cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider` (OAuth 2.1 for MCP clients) + MCP Apps widgets |
| AI | Vercel AI SDK v6, OpenRouter provider, `@cloudflare/think` / `agents` for SAM |
| Billing | Autumn (Stripe) credits, holds, top-ups, auto-reload |
| UI | Tailwind 4, shadcn on Base UI, lucide, recharts, leaflet (maps), sonner, react-markdown |
| Parsing | htmlparser2, cheerio (old), robots-parser, fast-xml-parser (sitemaps), tldts |
| Crawl auth | `web-bot-auth` / `http-message-sig` (signed crawler for Shopify) |
| Analytics | PostHog; self-host anonymous telemetry heartbeat |
| Tests | Vitest, Playwright (e2e incl. `tests/badseo` – a deliberately broken SEO site fixture) |

Auth modes (`AUTH_MODE`): `cloudflare_access`, `local_noauth`, `hosted`, `password` (Docker standalone), `everyapp`.

---

## 3. Code map

```
src/
  routes/                 TanStack file routes (UI + API)
    _app/p/$projectId/    per-project pages: index(dashboard), keywords, saved, domain, backlinks,
                          brand-lookup, prompt-explorer, ai-visibility(+prompts), audit(+issues),
                          rank-tracking, local-seo, search-performance, reports, sam, context, settings
    api/                  auth, autumn, ga4/oauth, gsc/oauth, local-seo/maps tiles, health
    s/$token              public share page for reports;  r/  report routes; report-map tiles
  serverFunctions/        RPC layer (createServerFn) – ~170 functions, see §6
  server/
    features/<feature>/{services,repositories}   business logic (service → repository)
    lib/dataforseo/       typed DataForSEO client (core, labs, serp, backlinks, business, ai, lighthouse, google-ads, pricing, request-slots)
    lib/audit/            crawler: discovery (robots/sitemap), url-policy (SSRF), throttle, page-analyzer, issues
    workflows/            durable jobs: SiteAuditWorkflow, RankCheckWorkflow, LocalRankWorkflow, AiVisibilityWorkflow
    mcp/tools/            MCP tool definitions (~90)
    features/sam/         in-app agent (system prompt, tools, skills)
  db/                     Drizzle schemas (sqlite + pg)
  client/features/        React feature modules mirroring server features
web/                      marketing site + free public tools (keyword generator, backlink checker, SERP simulator, …)
plugins/openseo/skills/   12 shipped agent skills (SKILL.md)
deploy/                   docker, standalone (nginx + runtime), alchemy (Cloudflare IaC)
```

Pattern enforced by AGENTS.md: **server function → service → repository**; every query scoped by `organizationId`/`projectId`; schema must work on SQLite and Postgres.

---

## 4. Domain model (extracted from `src/db/pg/*.schema.ts`)

### Identity / tenancy
- `user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`, `organization`, `member`, `invitation`, `apikey` (Better Auth).
- `user_onboarding_answers` (interested features, work-for, client site count, found via, MCP intent), `user_signup_campaigns` (UTM), `guest_accounts` (MCP guest w/ IP hash + claim token), `account_deletion_requests`.
- Roles: owner (billing), admin (projects, integrations). All invitees are admins.

### Projects
- `projects`: id, organization_id, name, brand_name, domain, location_code (default 2840 = US), language_code (en), ai_research_keywords, indexnow_key, archived.
- Project memory (spec 0010): `project_context_sections` (key, title, content, updated_by ∈ user|sam|mcp), `project_competitors` (domain, name, notes), `project_key_pages` (url, role ∈ hub|spoke|money|other, topic), `project_research_log` (date, summary).
- `project_activation_state`, `organization_activation_state`, `dashboard_step_dismissals`, `data_refresh_claims` (24 h refresh lock).

### Keywords
- `saved_keywords` (keyword, location, language), `saved_keyword_tags` (name, color), `saved_keyword_tag_assignments`.
- `keyword_metrics` cache: search_volume, cpc, competition, keyword_difficulty, intent, monthly_searches (JSON).

### Rank tracking
- `rank_tracking_configs`: domain, location_code, language, devices (desktop|mobile|both), serp_depth (10–100 step 10, default 40), schedule_interval (manual|daily|weekly|monthly), schedule time, location_name (city-level), is_active, last_skip_reason.
- `rank_tracking_keywords`: keyword, match_case, pinned, cached volume/KD/CPC.
- `rank_check_runs`: status, keywords_total/checked, is_subset_run, error.
- `rank_snapshots`: run_id, keyword, device, position (null = not found), url, serp_features (JSON).

### Backlinks
- `backlink_snapshots`: rank, backlinks, referring_domains, broken, new/lost backlinks, new/lost referring domains.

### Site audit
- `audits`: start_url, status, workflow id, config JSON, pages crawled/total, lighthouse total/completed/failed, current_phase, error code/detail, failed_phase.
- `audit_pages`: url, status_code, redirect_url, title, meta_description, canonical, robots_meta, og_*, word_count, images_total, images_missing_alt, internal/external link counts, has_structured_data, is_indexable, x_robots_tag, header canonical, crawl_depth, in_sitemap, content_hash, fetch_class, response_time_ms.
- `audit_issues`: page_id, page_url, issue_type, severity (critical|warning|info), details_json.
- `audit_lighthouse_results`: strategy (mobile|desktop), perf/a11y/best-practices/SEO scores, LCP, CLS, INP, TTFB.
- `crawler_credentials`: per-host signed-crawler credentials (Shopify).

### Local SEO (geo-grid rank tracking)
- `local_rank_trackers`: business title, address, cid, place_id, grid_size, language.
- `local_rank_keywords`, `local_rank_checks`, `local_rank_scans` (per keyword), `local_rank_points` (row, col, rank, results_count), `local_rank_businesses` (competitors in pack: title, cid, place_id, reviews), `local_rank_results` (point × business → rank). Grid spacing default 2 km, N×N points.

### AI visibility (LLM brand tracking)
- `ai_trackers`: engines enabled (chatgpt, gemini, claude, perplexity, google_ai_overview), market, schedule (daily|weekly|monthly), next_check_at.
- `ai_prompts`: topic, text, paused, archived.
- `ai_runs`: trigger (baseline|scheduled|manual), status (queued|running|completed|partial|failed).
- `ai_observations`: run × prompt × engine, branded, answer_markdown.
- `ai_sources`: cited url/domain/title/position.
- `ai_matches`: brand/competitor name+domain, own, mentioned, cited, first_mention.

### Integrations
- `gsc_connections` (project → property, connecting user's Google grant), `ga4_connections` (property id, tz, currency).

### Reports
- `reports`: title, summary (md ≤2500), html (≤500 KB), skill, template_id, created_by (client label), share_token (192-bit), shared_at.
- `report_templates`: name, description, instructions (md ≤3000), ≤10 per project.

### Agent / billing / telemetry
- `sam_sessions` (chat sessions per project/user).
- `billing_customer_status` (Autumn mirror). — **we drop billing entirely.**
- `telemetry_state` (install id, heartbeat, MCP call count).

---

## 5. External dependencies → what each feature costs them

DataForSEO endpoints in use (from `src/server/lib/dataforseo/*`):

| Area | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Keyword research | `dataforseo_labs/google/{keyword_suggestions,keyword_ideas,related_keywords,keyword_overview}/live`, `keywords_data/google_ads/{search_volume,keywords_for_keywords}/live` |
| Domain overview | `dataforseo_labs/google/{domain_rank_overview,ranked_keywords,relevant_pages,serp_competitors}/live` |
| SERP / rank tracking | `serp/google/organic/live/advanced`, `serp/google/organic/task_post` + `task_get/advanced`, `serp/google/locations/{iso}` |
| Backlinks | `backlinks/{summary,backlinks,referring_domains,domain_pages_summary,history}/live` |
| Local SEO | `serp/google/maps/{live,task_post,task_get}`, `serp/google/local_finder/live/advanced`, `business_data/business_listings/{search,categories}`, `business_data/google/{my_business_info,reviews,extended_reviews,questions_and_answers,my_business_updates}` |
| AI visibility | `ai_optimization/{chat_gpt,gemini}/llm_scraper`, `ai_optimization/perplexity/llm_responses/live`, `ai_optimization/llm_mentions/{search,top_pages,aggregated_metrics,cross_aggregated_metrics}/live` |
| Lighthouse | `on_page/lighthouse/live/json` |
| Misc | `appendix/user_data`, `appendix/goto_url_converter` |

Other: Google Search Console API (free), GA4 Data API (free), Google Map Tiles API (local SEO basemap), OpenRouter (SAM LLM), Context.dev / Cloudflare Browser Rendering (JS rendering for audits), Ahrefs DR lookup (`serverFunctions/ahrefs.ts`), IndexNow (Bing/Yandex/Yep, free), Loops (email), PostHog, Autumn/Stripe.

---

## 6. Feature inventory with flows

### 6.1 Projects & onboarding
- Create project (name, domain, country/language market). Archive / restore / delete archived.
- Onboarding: profile questions → website + country → "onboarding agent" (spec 0005): sitemap-first discovery → scrape 3–5 key pages to markdown → keyword data → one LLM call writes strategy, streamed live.
- `researchProjectWebsite` / `saveProjectWebsiteSetup`: reads site, proposes brand, competitors, keywords, key pages.
- Saving a website auto-starts first 50-page audit with JS rendering.

### 6.2 Dashboard (spec 0015)
Tabs: **Overview** (setup checklist, new search queries from GSC, recent link activity), **Keywords** (GSC new keywords, top keywords by clicks, striking-distance = pos 5–20 sorted by impressions), **Backlinks** (new / lost / live links, ≤25 ref domains, filters: text, link type, DR, spam score). Visit-triggered refresh every 24 h with refresh claims; failures keep old data.

### 6.3 Keyword research
- Input seed keyword(s) + market → modes: auto (blend suggestions+ideas), related, suggestions, ideas. Default 150 rows.
- Columns: keyword, volume, monthly trend (12 mo), CPC, competition, KD (0–100), intent badge, SERP features.
- SERP analysis card for a keyword (top results).
- Save keywords → **Saved keywords** list with tags (color), export CSV, refresh metrics, remove.
- City-level local volume (Google Ads `search_volume` with location_name).

### 6.4 Domain overview / competitor research
- Domain → rank overview (organic traffic estimate, keyword count, positions distribution), ranked keywords table (filters, paging), top pages table, SERP competitors, domain keyword suggestions (keywords competitor ranks for that you don't).

### 6.5 Backlinks
- Overview (summary: rank, backlinks, ref domains, broken, new/lost), backlinks rows, referring domains, top pages, history chart. Snapshots stored. Free tools: backlink checker, spam score checker, domain age checker.

### 6.6 Rank tracking
- Config per (project, domain, market[, city]): devices, depth, schedule (manual/daily/weekly/monthly, UTC time, weekday).
- Add/remove/pin keywords, cost estimate, trigger run (full or subset), RankCheckWorkflow posts SERP tasks, polls, records position + URL + SERP features per device.
- Views: latest results, keyword history, config trend (avg position, visibility), position matrix (keyword × date), skip reasons.

### 6.7 Site audit (free in OpenSEO — fully replicable)
Flow (`SiteAuditWorkflow`, spec 0009): start URL probe (≤5 redirects) → discovery (robots.txt ≤500 KB, sitemaps ≤3 levels/300 docs/10 MB, concurrency 5) → crawl (frontier in Durable Object scratchpad, adaptive throttle 1–10 s interval, cooldown up to 2 h on 429, SSRF url-policy, max HTML 1 MB, links/images ≤1000 per page) → optional JS rendering → per-page analysis → multi-page checks → Lighthouse sample (mobile/desktop) → persist → summary.
Config: max pages, render JS, Lighthouse on/off.

Issue rules (`src/server/lib/audit/issues/*`):

| Issue | Rule |
|---|---|
| missing-title / title-too-short / title-too-long | <10 or >60 chars |
| missing-meta-description / too-short / too-long | <70 or >160 chars |
| duplicate-title, duplicate-meta-description, duplicate-content | grouped across pages (content hash), sample 3 |
| broken-page | 4xx |
| server-error | 5xx |
| redirect-chain / redirect-loop | multi-hop / cycle |
| canonical-conflict / canonicalized-page | HTML vs header canonical mismatch / canonical points elsewhere |
| noindex-page / blocked-page | meta/X-Robots noindex / robots.txt disallow |
| thin-content | <150 words |
| images-missing-alt | count |
| heading-order-skip | e.g. H2 → H4 |
| deep-page | crawl depth ≥5 |
| no-outgoing-links | page has no internal links out |
| slow-response | >1.5 s (warn) / >10 s |
| rate-limited-page | 429 |
| javascript-rendering-suspected | low-content HTML suggesting CSR |
| Lighthouse issues | per-audit category failures, exportable |

Results UI: summary, pages table (filters), issues view grouped by type/severity, Lighthouse issues, rendering warnings, Shopify warnings, CSV export, audit history.

### 6.8 Local SEO
- Look up business (Google Business listing search → cid/place_id), create tracker with N×N grid (spacing ~2 km) around business, keywords.
- LocalRankWorkflow: per keyword × grid point Maps SERP → rank of business, competitors at each point. Heatmap on Leaflet with Google tiles. Business profile, reviews, Q&A, updates tools.

### 6.9 AI visibility (GEO / LLM SEO)
- Setup: generate prompts from keywords/topics (`generateAiVisibilityPrompts`, `researchAiVisibilityPrompts`), pick engines, schedule.
- Run (`AiVisibilityWorkflow`): for each prompt × engine fetch answer → parse cited sources → match own brand + competitors (mentioned, cited, first mention position).
- Results: share of voice, mention rate, citation rate, trend, sources (top cited domains/pages), per-answer view, CSV export.
- **Brand lookup** (LLM mentions aggregated metrics) and **Prompt explorer** (search what prompts mention a domain).

### 6.10 Search performance (GSC)
- OAuth incremental grant, pick property per project. Report: clicks, impressions, CTR, position by query/page/country/device/date; table + export; URL inspection (1–10 URLs).

### 6.11 Google Analytics 4
- Property per project. Reports: organic overview, landing pages, page performance, traffic acquisition, key events, ecommerce, site search, audience breakdown (device/country/new-vs-returning), measurement health.

### 6.12 IndexNow (spec 0016)
- Per-project 32-hex key, verify `https://host/{key}.txt` on bare + www, submit ≤10k URLs grouped by host → Bing, fallback Yandex → Yep.

### 6.13 Reports & templates (specs 0012–0014)
- Agents save self-contained HTML reports (≤500 KB, shape-checked), served sandboxed (CSP `sandbox`), print/export, full screen. Templates (≤10/project) are instruction briefs. Public share link `/s/<token>` (192-bit token, revocable, noindex, 60 s edge cache).

### 6.14 SAM (in-app AI agent)
- Chat sessions per project; tools include project data reads, `map_links`, `read_pages`, `get_product_info`; skills; system prompt with fact sheet; reads/writes project memory.

### 6.15 MCP server + Agent skills
- OAuth 2.1 MCP (consent page, org-bound credentials, spec 0017), API keys, guest accounts (spec 0019), MCP Apps widgets (interactive SERP & GSC views).
- Tools (90, grouped): projects/context (`list_projects`, `create_project`, `get/update_project_context`, `research_project_website`, `save_project_website_setup`, `whoami`); keywords (`research_keywords`, `get_keyword_metrics`, `get_suggested_keywords`, `get_domain_keyword_suggestions`, `save/list/remove_saved_keywords`); SERP (`get_serp_results`, `show_serp_results`, `find_serp_competitors`, `search_serp_locations`); domain (`get_domain_overview`, `get_ranked_keywords`, `get_search_opportunities`); backlinks (`get_backlinks_overview`, `get_backlinks_profile`); rank tracking (`create_rank_tracker`, `get_rank_tracker`, `add/remove/pin_rank_tracking_keywords`, `estimate_rank_tracker_cost`, `run_rank_tracker`, `get_rank_history`); audit (`run_site_audit`, `get_audit_status/issues/pages`, `list_site_audits`, `delete_site_audit`); local (`search_local_businesses`, `list_business_categories`, `get_local_serp_results`, `get_local_rank_grid`, `get_business_profile/reviews/updates`, `get_google_business_questions`); AI visibility (`generate/research_ai_visibility_prompts`, `save/get_ai_visibility_tracker`, `estimate_ai_visibility_cost`, `run_ai_visibility_check`, `get_ai_visibility_run/results/sources/trend/answer`, `export_ai_visibility_data`, `set_ai_visibility_schedule`, `explore_prompt`, `complete_ai_research_setup`); GSC (`list_search_console_sites`, `set_search_console_site`, `get_search_console_performance`, `show_search_console_performance`, `inspect_urls`); GA4 (`list/set_google_analytics_property`, 9 `get_google_analytics_*`); reports (`save/get/list/delete_report`, `save/list/delete_report_template`, `set_report_sharing`); `submit_indexnow_urls`.
- Skills (12): ai-prompt-research, ai-visibility-audit, competitive-landscape, competitor-analysis, keyword-clustering, keyword-research, link-prospecting, local-seo, seo-audit, seo-coach, seo-project-setup, seo-report.

### 6.16 Team, settings, account
- Invite teammates (admins), transfer ownership, switch org, MCP connections list/revoke, API keys, crawler credentials (Shopify), Google accounts removal impact, account deletion (grace period), product-update opt-in, terms acceptance.

### 6.17 Marketing site free tools (`web/`)
Keyword generator, competitor keyword finder, backlink checker, spam score checker, domain age checker, website traffic checker, SERP simulator — protected by Turnstile + budget caps.

### 6.18 Billing (hosted only — out of scope for us)
Autumn credits, holds, top-ups, auto-reload, plan upgrades, invoices. Each DataForSEO call = credit hold → actual cost → deduct.

---

## 7. Cross-cutting invariants worth copying
1. Every query tenant-scoped (org → project). Lookups by id return owner project, then authorize.
2. SSRF-safe fetcher for any user-supplied URL (block private IPs, redirects re-checked).
3. Long jobs are durable, resumable, idempotent; jobs never stay `running` forever (watchdog sets `failed` with reason).
4. Provider data cached with explicit freshness; failed refresh keeps last good data.
5. Agent-facing errors are written as instructions.
6. Unknown ≠ zero: missing metrics are `null`, never synthesized.
7. Reports sandboxed; share tokens are capabilities, revocation = null.

## 8. Weaknesses / gaps we can beat
- Paid data for every research feature → we go free-first (self-computed + free APIs + optional BYOK).
- Cloudflare lock-in & dual-dialect Drizzle complexity → single Postgres, single Docker Compose.
- No content optimization / on-page editor, no internal-link suggestions graph UI, no log-file analysis, no schema validator, no hreflang/i18n audit depth, no Core Web Vitals field data (CrUX), no alerting/digests, no white-label PDF, no keyword clustering in-app (skill only), no SERP volatility index, no content-gap tool UI, no change monitoring.

# 02 — Product Requirements Document (PRD)

**Product codename:** SeoSeo (working name; rename freely)
**Version:** 1.0 draft · 2026-11-10
**Owner:** jamal
**Reference product:** OpenSEO v0.1.26 (see `01-reverse-engineering-analysis.md`)

---

## 1. Vision
A **fully free, open-source, self-hostable SEO platform** with feature parity (and beyond) with OpenSEO / Semrush / Ahrefs core workflows, that works **with zero paid API keys**. Rust backend for speed and cheap hosting, Next.js frontend, one `docker compose up`.

## 2. Problem
- Semrush/Ahrefs cost $100–$500+/mo. OpenSEO is "open" but every research feature needs paid DataForSEO credits.
- Small businesses, freelancers, students, agencies in emerging markets can't afford either.
- AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) need an SEO data layer via MCP — today only paid.

## 3. Goals / Non-goals
**Goals**
- G1: Parity with all OpenSEO user-facing features (feature catalog `03`).
- G2: Zero required spend: every feature has a free data path (`05`).
- G3: One-command self-hosting via Docker Compose; runs on a 2 vCPU / 4 GB VPS for a small team.
- G4: First-class MCP server + agent skills, compatible with OpenSEO tool names where sensible.
- G5: Extras beyond OpenSEO (see §7 "Beyond parity").

**Non-goals (v1)**
- Billing, credits, Stripe, Autumn (no monetization layer).
- Cloudflare Workers deployment target.
- Multi-region SaaS operations / guest MCP accounts (hosted-only concepts).
- A full Google-scale backlink index (we use Common Crawl + first-party sources).

## 4. Personas
| Persona | Needs |
|---|---|
| **Solo site owner** | Audit site, find keywords, track ranks, see GSC data — free. |
| **Freelancer / agency** | Many projects, client reports, white-label share links, teammates. |
| **Developer / AI power user** | MCP tools in Claude Code/Codex, skills, API, self-host. |
| **Local business marketer** | Local grid ranking, GBP info, reviews. |
| **Content marketer** | Keyword clustering, content briefs, AI visibility (GEO). |

## 5. Success metrics
- Install-to-first-audit < 5 min.
- Audit 10k pages < 15 min on 4 vCPU (polite throttle permitting).
- p95 API latency < 200 ms for cached reads.
- MCP: all tools pass schema validation; ≥ 90 tools.
- GitHub stars / active installs (anonymous opt-in telemetry only).

## 6. Functional requirements (summary — full list with IDs in `03-feature-catalog.md`)

### 6.1 Workspace
- FR-WS-1 Email/password auth, optional Google OAuth, optional "no auth" mode for private networks; first visitor = admin.
- FR-WS-2 Organizations with owner/admin/member roles; invitation links; API keys; MCP OAuth connections list/revoke.
- FR-WS-3 Projects (name, domain, brand, market country+language, optional city), archive/restore/delete.
- FR-WS-4 Project memory: typed sections, competitors, key pages (hub/spoke/money), research log — editable by user, agent, MCP.
- FR-WS-5 Onboarding wizard: website → auto discovery (sitemap, key pages, brand, competitors, seed keywords) → first audit auto-starts.

### 6.2 Dashboard
- FR-DB-1 Setup checklist; Overview (health score, new GSC queries, link activity, rank movers, audit issues delta); Keywords tab (GSC new/top/striking distance 5–20); Backlinks tab (new/lost/live).
- FR-DB-2 24 h visit-triggered refresh with lock; failures keep last data.

### 6.3 Keyword research
- FR-KW-1 Seed → ideas (autocomplete expansion, questions, related, PAA), filters (volume bucket, KD, intent, word count, include/exclude), sort, paging, CSV export.
- FR-KW-2 Metrics: est. volume (bucket + confidence), trend, KD (computed), intent, SERP features; CPC when BYOK.
- FR-KW-3 SERP analysis for a keyword (top 10–100, DA/SR per result, features).
- FR-KW-4 Saved keywords + tags + refresh + export.
- FR-KW-5 Keyword clustering (SERP-overlap clustering) — *beyond parity*.
- FR-KW-6 Local (city) keyword context.

### 6.4 Competitive research
- FR-DO-1 Domain overview: SR (authority), est. traffic, ranked keywords, top pages, competitors, position distribution.
- FR-DO-2 Keyword gap / content gap between project and up to 4 competitors.
- FR-DO-3 Domain keyword suggestions (competitor ranks, you don't).

### 6.5 Backlinks
- FR-BL-1 Overview: SR, backlinks, referring domains, new/lost, history.
- FR-BL-2 Tables: backlinks (anchor, dofollow, first/last seen), referring domains, top linked pages, anchors.
- FR-BL-3 Spam score; link prospecting (domains linking to ≥2 competitors but not you).
- FR-BL-4 Snapshots & diffs.

### 6.6 Rank tracking
- FR-RT-1 Trackers per (project, domain, country[, city]); devices; depth 10–100; schedule manual/daily/weekly/monthly at chosen time+tz.
- FR-RT-2 Add/remove/pin/tag keywords, bulk import.
- FR-RT-3 Run full/subset; record position, URL, SERP features per device.
- FR-RT-4 Views: latest table w/ deltas, keyword history chart, visibility trend, position matrix, distribution buckets, cannibalization flags.
- FR-RT-5 Alerts on movement thresholds (email/webhook) — *beyond parity*.

### 6.7 Site audit
- FR-SA-1 Start URL, max pages, JS render toggle, Lighthouse toggle, include/exclude patterns, user-agent choice, crawl speed.
- FR-SA-2 Discovery via robots.txt + sitemaps (nested) + link following; SSRF-safe; adaptive throttle; 429 cooldown.
- FR-SA-3 All OpenSEO issue rules (see `01` §6.7) **plus**: missing/multiple H1, hreflang errors, mixed content, HTTP→HTTPS, orphan pages (sitemap but no inlinks), broken internal/external links, redirected internal links, missing/invalid structured data (JSON-LD validation), missing viewport/lang, large page size, uncompressed/unminified assets, image size/format, sitemap errors (non-200/noindex/canonicalized in sitemap), robots.txt issues, pagination, duplicate H1, URL hygiene (uppercase, params, length), soft-404 detection.
- FR-SA-4 Lighthouse lab scores + CWV; CrUX field data.
- FR-SA-5 Results: health score, issues by severity/category, pages table with filters, page detail (all extracted fields, in/out links), internal link graph view, audit comparison (fixed/new issues), CSV/PDF export, scheduled re-audits.

### 6.8 Local SEO
- FR-LO-1 Business lookup (OSM / Places key), tracker with grid N×N (3,5,7,9), spacing km, keywords.
- FR-LO-2 Grid scan → heatmap (MapLibre + OSM), ARP/ATRP/SoLV metrics, competitors per point.
- FR-LO-3 Business profile, reviews (with Places key), NAP consistency check across own site schema.

### 6.9 AI visibility (GEO)
- FR-AI-1 Tracker: engines (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Perplexity, Ollama/local, Google AI Overview via SERP), market, schedule.
- FR-AI-2 Prompt generation from keywords/topics (LLM) + manual prompts; pause/archive.
- FR-AI-3 Runs: answer, cited sources, brand & competitor mentions/citations, first-mention position.
- FR-AI-4 Metrics: share of voice, mention rate, citation rate, trend; source domains leaderboard; answer viewer; export.
- FR-AI-5 Brand lookup & prompt explorer over instance-wide answer index.

### 6.10 Integrations
- FR-IN-1 GSC: OAuth, property per project, performance explorer (query/page/country/device/date, filters, compare periods), URL inspection, export.
- FR-IN-2 GA4: property per project, organic overview, landing pages, acquisition, key events, ecommerce, site search, audience, measurement health.
- FR-IN-3 Bing Webmaster Tools: inbound links, query stats.
- FR-IN-4 IndexNow key setup/verify/submit (+ auto-submit changed pages from audits, opt-in).
- FR-IN-5 Webhooks + outgoing Slack/Discord notifications.

### 6.11 Reports
- FR-RP-1 HTML reports saved by agents or generated from built-in templates (audit, rank, keyword, backlink, AI visibility); sandboxed viewer; print/PDF export.
- FR-RP-2 Templates (instruction briefs, branding: logo, accent color) — white-label.
- FR-RP-3 Public share links (token, revocable, noindex) — available in self-host too (no hosted-only restriction).
- FR-RP-4 Scheduled email digests (weekly) — *beyond parity*.

### 6.12 AI assistant ("Sam" equivalent)
- FR-AG-1 In-app chat per project, streaming, tool-calling over our own API, reads/writes project memory; works with Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- FR-AG-2 Content brief generator & on-page optimizer (score page vs top-10 SERP terms) — *beyond parity*.

### 6.13 MCP & API
- FR-MCP-1 Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, dynamic client registration) + API key auth; credentials bound to one org.
- FR-MCP-2 Tool set ≥ OpenSEO's (names kept compatible), discriminated success/error outputs, errors phrased as instructions.
- FR-MCP-3 Ship agent skills (port the 12 + clustering/content-brief/local).
- FR-API-1 Public REST API with OpenAPI 3.1 spec (same handlers as UI).

### 6.14 Free tools (public, no login, rate-limited)
Keyword generator, SERP preview/simulator, backlink checker, domain authority checker, domain age checker, robots.txt tester, sitemap validator, meta tag checker, schema validator, redirect checker, hreflang checker.

### 6.15 Admin / ops
- Settings for provider adapters (enable/disable, keys, rate limits), job queue dashboard, storage usage, backup/restore, telemetry opt-in (off by default).

## 7. Beyond parity (differentiators)
Keyword clustering UI · content brief + on-page score · internal-link suggestions & graph · audit comparison & scheduled audits · CrUX field data · alerts & digests · white-label PDF · Bing WMT · tech-stack detection · log-file analysis (upload access logs → bot crawl stats) · SERP volatility index from own tracking data · change monitoring (title/meta/canonical/robots diffs on key pages) · multi-language UI.

## 8. Non-functional requirements
| Area | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Performance | Crawler ≥ 20 pages/s (throttle-limited per host); API p95 < 200 ms cached |
| Scale | 1 instance: 50 projects, 100k audited pages, 10k tracked keywords |
| Reliability | Durable jobs (Postgres-backed queue), resumable, watchdog fails stuck jobs with reason |
| Security | Argon2id passwords, CSRF, secure cookies, RBAC, tenant scoping on every query, SSRF guard, encrypted OAuth tokens (AES-256-GCM), sandboxed report HTML, rate limiting |
| Privacy | No telemetry by default; all data stays on the instance |
| Ethics | Crawlers obey robots.txt (configurable UA), polite rates; scraping adapters opt-in, never bypass CAPTCHAs |
| Portability | Docker Compose, amd64 + arm64 images |
| Observability | `tracing` JSON logs, `/health`, `/metrics` (Prometheus) |
| Accessibility | WCAG 2.1 AA UI |
| i18n | UI strings externalized |

## 9. Release plan
See `07-roadmap.md` (M0 foundation → M8 polish). MVP = M0–M3 (auth, projects, audit, keywords, SERP, rank tracking, GSC, MCP core).

## 10. Open questions
1. Product name & license (MIT like OpenSEO, or AGPL to keep forks open?).
2. Instance-wide SERP/answer index sharing between orgs on one instance — default on (better data) or off (isolation)?
3. Ship Ollama in default compose (big image) or as optional profile? (Proposed: optional profile `--profile ai`.)
4. Bundle SearXNG by default? (Proposed: yes, profile `serp`.)

# 04 — Technical Architecture (Rust + Next.js + Docker)

Versions verified 2026-11-10 (npm registry, crates.io, Docker Hub). **Re-verify at scaffold time** (use context7 / `cargo search` / `npm view`); always take latest stable.

## 1. Stack

### Backend (Rust)
| Concern | Choice | Version |
|---|---|---|
| Toolchain | Rust stable, edition 2024 | 1.99.x |
| Async runtime | tokio | 1.54 |
| HTTP framework | axum (+ tower, tower-http: cors, compression, trace, timeout, limit) | 0.8.9 / tower-http 0.7 |
| DB | PostgreSQL | 18.x |
| DB access | sqlx (compile-time checked queries, migrations) | pinned in renderer/package-lock.json |
| Cache / rate-limit / pubsub | Valkey (Redis-compatible) via `redis` crate | Valkey 9.x / redis 1.8 |
| Job queue | Postgres-backed queue (`apalis` 1.0 with postgres backend, or hand-rolled `SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`) | 1.0 |
| Scheduler | cron-like table polled by worker (tz-aware via `chrono-tz`) | — |
| HTTP client | reqwest (rustls) | 0.13 |
| HTML parsing | `lol_html` (streaming, low memory) for crawl extraction; `scraper` for SERP parsing | 3.0 / 0.29 |
| robots.txt | `texting_robots` | 0.2 |
| Sitemaps | `quick-xml` | latest |
| URL/domain | `url`, `publicsuffix`/`psl`, `idna` | latest |
| Headless browser | Puppeteer → isolated `renderer` container (Chromium + Lighthouse), guarded egress proxy | pinned in renderer/package-lock.json |
| MCP | `rmcp` (official Rust MCP SDK, streamable HTTP server) | 3.9 |
| OpenAPI | `utoipa` + `utoipa-swagger-ui`/scalar | 6.0 |
| Auth | `argon2` (passwords), `jsonwebtoken` (OAuth/MCP tokens), `oauth2` crate (Google), cookie sessions in Valkey | 0.6 / 11 |
| Crypto | `aes-gcm` (encrypt OAuth refresh tokens), `rand` | latest |
| Serialization | serde, serde_json | 1.0 |
| Validation | `validator` / `garde` | latest |
| Errors | `thiserror` (lib), `anyhow` (bins) | latest |
| Observability | tracing, tracing-subscriber (JSON), `metrics` + prometheus exporter | 0.1 |
| Config | `figment` or `config` from env | latest |
| Testing | `cargo nextest`, `sqlx::test`, `wiremock`, `insta` snapshots | latest |
| LLM | `async-openai`-compatible client (works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM), Anthropic + Gemini adapters | latest |

### Frontend (Next.js)
| Concern | Choice | Version |
|---|---|---|
| Framework | Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Turbopack | 16.4 |
| React | React | 19.3 |
| Language | TypeScript | 7.0 |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui | 4.3 / shadcn 4.23 |
| Server state | TanStack Query | 5.107 |

| Forms | react-hook-form or TanStack Form + Zod 4 | zod 4.6 |

| Maps | MapLibre GL + OSM / PMTiles | latest |
| API client | generated from OpenAPI (`openapi-typescript` + `openapi-fetch`) | latest |
| Auth | httpOnly session cookie set by Rust API; Next middleware checks session via API | — |
| Testing | Vitest, Playwright | latest |
| Package manager | pnpm | latest |
| Runtime image | Node LTS (26.x) `output: "standalone"` | — |

## 2. System diagram

```
             ┌──────────────┐        ┌───────────────┐
 Browser ───▶│  web (Next)  │──REST─▶│   api (axum)  │◀── MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor)
             └──────────────┘        │  /api/v1/*    │      /mcp  (streamable HTTP, OAuth2.1 / API key)
                                     │  /mcp         │
                                     └──────┬────────┘
                         enqueue jobs       │  read/write
                ┌───────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────┐
                ▼                           ▼                         ▼
        ┌──────────────┐           ┌──────────────┐           ┌──────────────┐
        │ worker (Rust)│──────────▶│ Postgres 18  │◀──────────│ Valkey       │
        │ crawler, SERP│           │ (data, queue)│           │ cache, locks,│
        │ rank, AI, CC │           └──────────────┘           │ rate limits, │
        └──┬───┬───┬───┘                                      │ SSE pubsub   │
           │   │   │                                          └──────────────┘
           │   │   └──▶ renderer (Chromium + Lighthouse, CDP)
           │   └──────▶ searxng (optional SERP meta-search)
           └──────────▶ external free APIs (GSC, GA4, PSI, CrUX, Trends, autocomplete,
                         Common Crawl, RDAP, IndexNow, Bing WMT, LLM providers / ollama)
```

`api` and `worker` are the **same Rust binary** with different subcommands (`seoseo serve`, `seoseo worker`, `seoseo migrate`, `seoseo admin …`) — one image, simpler ops.

## 3. Repository layout (planned)

```
seoseo/
├─ CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md          # agent context (aimem-managed block)
├─ .aimem/                        # project notebook (decisions, memories, handoffs)
├─ docs/                          # this documentation set
├─ reference/open-seo/            # cloned reference (git-ignored)
├─ backend/
│  ├─ Cargo.toml                  # workspace
│  ├─ crates/
│  │  ├─ app/          (bin)      # main: serve | worker | migrate | admin
│  │  ├─ api/                     # axum routers, extractors, auth middleware, OpenAPI
│  │  ├─ mcp/                     # rmcp tool definitions → call domain services
│  │  ├─ domain/                  # services: projects, keywords, rank, audit, links, local, ai, reports, gsc, ga4
│  │  ├─ db/                      # sqlx repositories, migrations/
│  │  ├─ jobs/                    # queue, scheduler, job handlers (audit, rank, local, ai, cc-ingest, refresh)
│  │  ├─ crawler/                 # fetcher, url-policy (SSRF), robots, sitemaps, throttle, analyzer, issue rules
│  │  ├─ providers/               # trait-based adapters: serp/, keywords/, trends/, links/, authority/, llm/, places/, lighthouse/, gsc/, ga4/, bing/, indexnow/, rdap/
│  │  ├─ metrics/                 # KD, SR, traffic est., spam score, intent, clustering
│  │  └─ common/                  # config, errors, ids, telemetry, crypto
│  └─ Dockerfile
├─ frontend/
│  ├─ app/(auth)/ (app)/p/[projectId]/{dashboard,keywords,saved,domain,backlinks,rank-tracking,audit,local,ai-visibility,search-performance,analytics,reports,assistant,context,settings}
│  ├─ components/ui (shadcn) · features/* · lib/api (generated)
│  └─ Dockerfile
├─ skills/                        # agent skills (SKILL.md) ported from OpenSEO
├─ deploy/
│  ├─ compose.yaml                # production
│  ├─ compose.dev.yaml            # dev overrides (mailpit, hot reload)
│  ├─ searxng/settings.yml
│  └─ renderer/Dockerfile
└─ .env.example
```

Layering rule (from OpenSEO, keep it): **router/MCP tool → service (domain) → repository (db)**. Providers are only called from services. Every repository function takes `OrgId`/`ProjectId` explicitly.

## 4. Data model (Postgres)
Port OpenSEO tables (see `01` §4) with these changes:
- Single dialect (Postgres): use `uuid` (v7) PKs, `timestamptz`, `jsonb`, enums as `text` + CHECK, `citext` for emails/domains.
- Drop: billing tables, guest accounts, telemetry tables (replace with `instance_settings`).
- Add:
  - `provider_settings(org_id, provider, enabled, config jsonb, secret_enc bytea)`
  - `jobs(id, kind, payload jsonb, status, attempts, run_at, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, progress jsonb)` + `schedules(id, kind, target_id, interval, hour, minute, weekday, tz, next_run_at)`
  - `serp_results(id, engine, keyword, location, language, device, fetched_at, raw_hash)` + `serp_items(result_id, position, type, url, domain, title, snippet, features)` — instance-wide SERP index (powers domain overview, KD, competitors).
  - `domains(domain citext pk, sr_score, cc_harmonic, cc_pagerank, tranco_rank, first_seen, rdap_created_at, tech jsonb, spam_score)`
  - `links(src_url, src_domain, dst_url, dst_domain, anchor, rel, first_seen, last_seen, source enum{cc,crawl,bing,import})` partitioned by `dst_domain` hash.
  - `keyword_cache(keyword, location, language, est_volume, volume_bucket, confidence, trend jsonb, kd, intent, features, updated_at)`
  - `audit_links(audit_id, from_page, to_url, anchor, rel, status)` for link graph & broken links.
  - `alerts`, `webhooks`, `notification_channels`.
- All project-scoped tables: FK `project_id → projects ON DELETE CASCADE`, index `(project_id, …)`.

## 5. Job system
- Kinds: `site_audit`, `audit_lighthouse`, `rank_check`, `local_scan`, `ai_visibility_run`, `keyword_refresh`, `backlink_snapshot`, `cc_domain_ingest`, `cc_graph_import`, `gsc_refresh`, `report_digest`, `indexnow_submit`.
- Postgres queue with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, lease + heartbeat, exponential retry, max attempts, dead-letter status `failed` with reason. Watchdog marks expired leases.
- Long jobs are **phased & checkpointed** (audit: probe → discover → crawl → render → analyze → lighthouse → finalize), state in DB so restarts resume (OpenSEO spec 0009 lesson).
- Progress events → Valkey pubsub → SSE endpoint `/api/v1/jobs/{id}/events` for live UI.
- Per-host politeness: token bucket in Valkey keyed by host; global concurrency limits per provider.

## 6. Crawler design
- Fetcher: reqwest + custom DNS resolver that rejects private/loopback/link-local/metadata IPs (SSRF), re-validated on each redirect; max body 8 MB, HTML 1 MB parsed; timeouts; gzip/br.
- Frontier: per-audit table `audit_frontier(url_hash, url, depth, source, state)` — dedupe by normalized URL.
- Extract with `lol_html` streaming handlers → title, meta, canonical, robots, hreflang, headings, links (≤1000), images (≤1000), JSON-LD blocks, OG, word count (text nodes), content hash (simhash for near-duplicates).
- Rules engine: each rule = `fn(&PageFacts) -> Vec<Issue>` or multi-page `fn(&AuditIndex) -> Vec<Issue>`; severity & thresholds configurable; rule registry documented & versioned.
- Rendering: if `render_js`, send URL to renderer (CDP) → post-render HTML → same pipeline; compare raw vs rendered to flag JS-dependent content.

## 7. Provider abstraction
```rust
#[async_trait]
pub trait SerpProvider: Send + Sync {
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str;
    fn capabilities(&self) -> SerpCaps;               // engines, devices, local, depth
    async fn search(&self, q: &SerpQuery) -> Result<SerpPage, ProviderError>;
}
// Similar traits: KeywordIdeaProvider, VolumeEstimator, TrendsProvider, BacklinkProvider,
// AuthorityProvider, LlmProvider, PlacesProvider, LighthouseProvider, RdapProvider.
```
- Registry built per-org from `provider_settings`; fallback chain (e.g. `serp = [searxng, chromium_google, brave]`).
- Every response records `provider`, `fetched_at`, `confidence` → surfaced in UI/MCP.
- Global request budgets & rate limits per provider to stay inside free tiers.

## 8. Auth & security
- Sessions: opaque random id in httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie; session store in Valkey + Postgres.
- CSRF: double-submit token for cookie-auth mutating requests; API keys/Bearer exempt.
- RBAC: `owner` > `admin` > `member`; checked in service layer with `Actor { user_id, org_id, role }`.
- MCP: OAuth 2.1 authorization server in Rust (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration, consent page in Next) + API keys; tokens bound to one org (OpenSEO spec 0017).
- Secrets at rest: AES-256-GCM with `APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY`.
- Reports: served from `/r/{id}/raw` with `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox; default-src 'none'; img-src data: https:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'` and `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`.
- Rate limiting: tower-governor / Valkey sliding window on auth & public tools.

## 9. API conventions
- REST under `/api/v1`, JSON, cursor pagination (`?cursor=&limit=`), `ProblemDetails` (RFC 9457) errors, OpenAPI 3.1 at `/api/v1/openapi.json`, docs at `/api/docs`.
- Project-scoped routes: `/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/…` (OpenSEO spec 0001 lesson: projectId explicit in every call).
- Long ops return `202 { job_id }`; poll `GET /jobs/{id}` or SSE.
- Exports: `GET …/export.csv` streaming.

## 10. Docker
Services in `deploy/compose.yaml`:

| Service | Image | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `db` | `postgres:18-alpine` | volume `pgdata`, healthcheck |
| `cache` | `valkey/valkey:9-alpine` | AOF on |
| `api` | `ghcr.io/<you>/seoseo-backend` | `seoseo serve`, port 8080 |
| `worker` | same image | `seoseo worker`, scale replicas |
| `migrate` | same image | `seoseo migrate` one-shot, `api` depends_on completed |
| `web` | `ghcr.io/<you>/seoseo-frontend` | Next standalone, port 3000 |
| `renderer` | Node + Chromium + Puppeteer + Lighthouse; private network; guarded egress proxy | internal only |
| `searxng` | `searxng/searxng` | profile `serp` |
| `ollama` | `ollama/ollama` | profile `ai` |
| `proxy` | `caddy:2` | optional profile `tls`, auto HTTPS |
| `mailpit` | `axllent/mailpit` | dev only |

Backend Dockerfile: multi-stage `rust:1.99-slim-bookworm` + `cargo-chef` cache → `gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12` (or `debian:bookworm-slim` + ca-certs) runtime, non-root. `SQLX_OFFLINE=true` with `.sqlx/` committed.
Frontend Dockerfile: `node:26-alpine` + pnpm, `next build` with `output: "standalone"` → slim runtime, non-root.
Multi-arch build (amd64/arm64) via `docker buildx` in GitHub Actions.

## 11. Environment variables (initial)
```
DATABASE_URL, VALKEY_URL, APP_BASE_URL, WEB_BASE_URL, APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY (32B base64), SESSION_SECRET,
AUTH_MODE=password|none|oidc, SMTP_URL, SMTP_FROM,
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET            # GSC/GA4 (+ optional login)
PAGESPEED_API_KEY, CRUX_API_KEY, BING_WMT_API_KEY, GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY   # optional, free tiers
SEARXNG_URL, RENDERER_URL, OLLAMA_URL, OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL, OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY, LLM_MODEL
DATAFORSEO_LOGIN, DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD, SERPAPI_KEY, SERPER_KEY, BRAVE_API_KEY   # optional BYOK
CRAWLER_USER_AGENT, CRAWLER_MAX_CONCURRENCY, SERP_SCRAPE_ENABLED=false
RUST_LOG, TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false
```

# 05 — Free Data Strategy (replacing DataForSEO)

OpenSEO's research features are 100% DataForSEO (paid). Our promise is **"completely free"**: free software, free to self-host, and **usable with zero paid API keys**. This doc maps every paid OpenSEO data need to a free source, and states honestly where free data is weaker.

## Principles
1. **Free-first, BYOK-optional.** Every data capability is a Rust trait (`Provider`) with a free default adapter. Users may plug in paid keys (DataForSEO, SerpApi, Serper, Brave paid, OpenAI…) to upgrade quality. Nothing in the product *requires* money.
2. **Compute, don't buy.** We own a crawler + link graph + SERP cache. Metrics like Keyword Difficulty, Domain Authority, traffic estimates are *computed* by us from raw signals, with documented formulas.
3. **First-party data beats estimates.** GSC (real impressions/clicks/positions), GA4, Bing Webmaster Tools are free and authoritative for the user's own sites — surfaced everywhere.
4. **Label confidence.** Every metric carries `source` + `confidence` (`measured` | `estimated` | `relative`). Unknown = `null`, never 0 (OpenSEO invariant).
5. **Respect ToS & robots.** Adapters that scrape third-party sites are opt-in, rate-limited, off by default, and documented with their legal caveats. The user chooses.
6. **Cache aggressively.** Shared SERP / keyword / domain caches with TTLs so repeated research costs nothing.

## Capability map

| Capability | OpenSEO (paid) | Our free default | Free/optional upgrades | Quality note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Keyword ideas / suggestions** | Labs keyword_suggestions/ideas/related | Autocomplete expansion (Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, DuckDuckGo suggest) with a–z / question / preposition modifiers; "People also ask" + "related searches" from SERP fetches; GSC queries for own sites; Wikipedia related titles | DataForSEO / Keywords Everywhere BYOK | Breadth ≈ paid tools for long-tail. |
| **Search volume** | Google Ads search_volume | **Estimated volume model**: Google Trends relative interest (unofficial endpoint, cached) × anchor calibration (GSC impressions of connected sites, Wikipedia pageviews for entity terms) → bucketed estimate; autocomplete rank as weak signal | DataForSEO / Google Ads API (user's own Ads account, own use) | Labeled `estimated`; show buckets (10–100, 100–1K …) not fake precision. |
| **Trend (12–60 mo)** | monthly_searches | Google Trends (relative 0–100) | — | Good. |
| **CPC / competition** | Google Ads | Not available free → `null`; optional heuristic from ad-count in SERP (ads present = commercial) | BYOK | Honest null. |
| **Keyword Difficulty** | Labs KD | **Computed**: f(our Domain Authority of top-10 URLs, page-level link counts, SERP features, presence of big brands/UGC) 0–100 | — | Same method most tools use. |
| **Search intent** | Labs | Rule classifier (modifiers: buy/price/best/how/what/near me, brand list) + SERP-feature signals (shopping, local pack, featured snippet) + optional local LLM (Ollama) | Any LLM key | Good. |
| **SERP results / rank tracking** | serp/google/organic | **Pluggable SERP fetcher**: (a) self-hosted **SearXNG** container (bundled in compose) ; (b) direct headless Chromium fetch of Google/Bing with polite rate limits & user's own IP/proxy (opt-in, ToS caveat) ; (c) Brave Search API / Mojeek API free tiers if available | SerpApi, Serper, DataForSEO, Brave paid BYOK | Positions from (a) are aggregated, not exact Google; (b) is exact but rate-limited. Rank tracking defaults to (b) for small keyword sets with jittered schedule. |
| **SERP locations / geo** | serp/google/locations | **GeoNames** dump (cities ≥1000 pop, admin regions) + Google `uule` encoder for local SERP | — | Full parity. |
| **Domain Authority** | Labs domain rank / Ahrefs DR | **Our "SeoSeo Rank" (SR)**: harmonic-centrality / PageRank from **Common Crawl host-level web graph** (free, quarterly) normalized 0–100; refreshed from our own crawl link graph | Open PageRank API (free key) as secondary signal | Strong & transparent. |
| **Backlinks (list)** | backlinks/backlinks | (1) **Common Crawl**: CC index + WAT link extraction job for a target domain (batch, async, cached) ; (2) **Bing Webmaster Tools API** inbound links for verified own sites (free) ; (3) our own crawler's discovered edges ; (4) GSC "Links" not in API → manual CSV import | DataForSEO / Ahrefs BYOK | Coverage lower than Ahrefs; first-party sites near-complete via Bing WMT. New/lost computed by diffing snapshots. |
| **Referring domains, anchors, top pages, history** | backlinks/* | Derived from link store above | — | — |
| **Spam score** | DataForSEO | **Computed** heuristic (TLD, outbound link ratio, thin pages, link farms, anchor over-optimization) | — | Documented formula. |
| **Domain overview: traffic, ranked keywords, top pages, competitors** | Labs ranked_keywords etc. | **Our SERP cache index**: every SERP we ever fetch (any user on this instance, opt-in sharing) is stored → inverted index domain→keywords/positions. Traffic estimate = Σ est_volume × CTR(position). Competitors = domains co-occurring in same SERPs. Tranco + Cloudflare Radar top-domain ranks as popularity prior. For own sites: GSC exact. | DataForSEO BYOK | Grows with usage; strongest for niches the user researches. Seed packs (public keyword lists) optional. |
| **Content gap / keyword gap** | Labs | Diff of ranked-keyword sets from SERP index + GSC | — | — |
| **Site audit crawl** | own crawler (free) | **Own Rust crawler** | — | Better (faster, more checks). |
| **JS rendering** | Cloudflare Browser / Context.dev (paid) | **Headless Chromium** (Puppeteer) in a `renderer` container | — | Full parity, free. |
| **Lighthouse / CWV lab** | on_page/lighthouse (paid) | **Lighthouse CLI** in renderer container; or **PageSpeed Insights API** (free key, generous quota) | — | Parity. |
| **CWV field data** | — (missing) | **CrUX API** (free key) | — | New feature. |
| **Local pack / Maps rank grid** | serp/google/maps | Headless Maps/local-finder fetch per grid point with `uule`/geo override (opt-in, rate-limited); OSM **Overpass/Nominatim** for business lookup & competitors | Google Places API (user key, free monthly allowance), DataForSEO BYOK | Grid scans are request-heavy → small grids (3×3/5×5) by default. |
| **Business profile / reviews / Q&A** | business_data/* | Google Places API (user key) for details & 5 reviews; OSM tags | DataForSEO BYOK | Partial. |
| **AI visibility (LLM answers)** | ai_optimization llm_scraper | **BYO LLM keys** (OpenAI w/ web-search tool, Anthropic w/ web search, Gemini w/ Google grounding, Perplexity Sonar) **or local Ollama models** **or OpenRouter free models**. Google AI Overview captured from SERP fetch when present. | — | Answers via API differ slightly from consumer UI; documented. Tool is free; LLM usage is user's own account or local. |
| **LLM mentions database / prompt explorer** | llm_mentions/* | Built from our own stored AI-visibility answers (instance-wide index) | — | Grows with usage. |
| **Domain age / WHOIS** | — | **RDAP** (free, IANA bootstrap) | — | Parity. |
| **Tech stack detection** | — (missing) | Open Wappalyzer-compatible fingerprints (webappanalyzer) | — | New. |
| **Indexing** | IndexNow (free) | IndexNow + Google Indexing API (for eligible types) + sitemap ping | — | Parity+. |
| **GSC / GA4** | free | Same (user's Google OAuth client) | — | Parity. |
| **Bing Webmaster** | — | Bing WMT API (free key) | — | New. |
| **In-app AI agent** | OpenRouter (paid) | Ollama (local, bundled optional profile) / OpenRouter free models / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint | — | Free with local models. |
| **Maps basemap** | Google Map Tiles (paid) | **OpenStreetMap** tiles (or self-hosted protomaps PMTiles) via MapLibre | — | Free. |
| **Email** | Loops | SMTP (any) / Mailpit in dev | — | Free. |

## Implementation notes (M2, 2026-11-11)
- **Google Trends is not wired up.** Its unofficial endpoint only answers a browser-like User-Agent plus a cookie handshake, which means working around a bot check; that breaks principle 5. Trend and volume estimates currently come from **Wikipedia pageviews** (official API) for keywords that match an article; everything else shows relative **popularity** (0–100 within a research) and a null volume.
- **DuckDuckGo suggest** returns nothing to an honest (non-browser) User-Agent, so it is not an adapter. Google and Bing suggest endpoints work with our real User-Agent.
- SERP order of preference: Serper (BYOK, exact Google) → Brave API (BYOK) → SearXNG (bundled, `--profile serp`) → Chromium/Bing (explicit opt-in, `--profile renderer`; robots and bot blocks may make it unavailable).
- SR import streams only the first N lines of the rank file (sorted by harmonic centrality): 1M domains ≈ 30 MB.

## Data freshness defaults
| Data | TTL |
|---|---|
| SERP (research) | 7 days |
| SERP (rank tracking) | per schedule, never cached across runs |
| Autocomplete / trends | 30 days |
| Domain rank (Common Crawl graph) | per CC release (~quarterly) |
| Backlink snapshot (CC) | per CC release; Bing WMT daily |
| Keyword metrics | 30 days |
| Lighthouse | per audit |

## Risks & mitigations
- **Search-engine scraping ToS / blocks** → opt-in adapter, low default rates, jitter, backoff, cache-first, CAPTCHA = stop (never bypass), SearXNG default, BYOK path documented.
- **Common Crawl size** (TB-scale) → never download full crawl; use host-graph ranks (GB) + CC Index API per-domain queries + targeted WAT range requests; precompute in background worker; optional "lite" mode skips CC.
- **Volume accuracy** → buckets + confidence labels; GSC calibration when connected.

# 08 — Site Audit: How It Works (M1)

Design record for the shipped site audit. Read this before changing the crawler, rules or audit job.

## Flow

```
POST /projects/{id}/audits ──► audits row (queued) + jobs row (site_audit)
                                   │
worker claims job ─► probe ─► discover ─► crawl ─► analyze ─► completed
                      │          │          │          │
                      │          │          │          └ link graph → inlinks, click depth (BFS),
                      │          │          │            site rules, issue counts, health score
                      │          │          └ frontier batches (depth-first order by depth,url),
                      │          │            robots check, fetch (concurrency N, delay), extract,
                      │          │            page rules, store page+links+issues in one tx
                      │          └ robots.txt sitemaps (or /sitemap.xml), nested ≤3 levels/300 docs
                      └ fetch start URL; follow redirects (http→https, apex→www) to set scope
UI: GET …/audits/{id}/events (SSE, 1 s DB poll) with 5 s polling fallback
```

## Where the code lives
| Concern | File |
|---|---|
| SSRF guard (URL + resolved IP) | `backend/crates/crawler/src/policy.rs` |
| Fetcher (manual redirects, caps, classification) | `backend/crates/crawler/src/fetch.rs` |
| robots.txt / sitemaps | `crawler/src/robots.rs`, `crawler/src/sitemap.rs` |
| HTML extraction (lol_html, streaming) | `crawler/src/extract.rs` |
| Issue catalog, page rules, site rules, score | `crawler/src/rules.rs` |
| Orchestration (phases, resume) | `backend/crates/jobs/src/site_audit.rs` |
| Persistence | `backend/crates/db/src/audits.rs`, migration `0002_site_audit.sql` |
| API | `backend/crates/api/src/routes/audits.rs` |
| UI | `frontend/app/(app)/p/[projectId]/audit/**` |

## Invariants
- **SSRF**: every URL passes `UrlPolicy::check_url`; the reqwest DNS resolver drops private/reserved IPs, so redirects and DNS rebinding cannot reach internal hosts. `CRAWLER_ALLOW_PRIVATE=true` exists only for the `badseo` test overlay.
- **Resumable**: frontier, pages, links and issues live in Postgres. Pages are unique per `(audit_id, url_hash)` and inserted with their links/issues in one transaction, at most once. Site rules are deleted and recomputed in `analyze`. A killed worker's job is requeued when its lease expires (≤ ~3 min) and continues from the frontier.
- **Redirecting URLs** are stored with their chain but no content, links or content issues; the in-scope destination is crawled as its own page.
- **Click depth** comes from BFS over the stored link graph in `analyze`, not from discovery order (sitemap URLs would otherwise look shallow). Unreachable pages have depth `-1`.
- **Budgets**: `max_pages` (≤10 000), frontier capped at 5× pages, 2 h wall clock, stop after 3 consecutive 429s, robots `Crawl-delay` honoured (≤10 s), HTML parsed up to 1 MiB, response read up to 8 MiB, links/images ≤1000 per page.
- **Thresholds** match OpenSEO: title 10–60, description 70–160, thin < 150 words, deep ≥ 5 clicks, slow > 1.5 s.

## Issue catalog (38 types)
Served at `GET /api/v1/audit-issue-types` with explanation and fix text. Critical: blocked-page, server-error, broken-internal-link, missing-title, redirect-loop. Warnings include duplicates, thin content, missing description/H1, canonical conflicts, orphan pages, mixed content, invalid JSON-LD, JS-rendering suspected. Notices include title/description length, heading skips, noindex, canonicalized, deep pages, slow responses, robots-disallowed, sitemap-non-indexable.

Health score = 100 − Σ(affected-page share × weight), weights critical 30 / warning 8 / info 1.

## Testing
- Unit: `crawler` crate (URL policy, normalization, robots, sitemap parsing incl. entities/CDATA, extraction, every rule, score).
- Fixture: `deploy/test/badseo/` (nginx) with one page per defect; `deploy/compose.test.yaml` adds it.
- E2E: `scripts/e2e-audit.sh` asserts all 26 fixture issue types are found and a clean page has none; `scripts/e2e-team.sh` covers invitations.
- Crash-resume was verified manually by SIGKILLing the worker mid-crawl (job attempt 2, identical results, no duplicate pages).

## Known gaps (later milestones)
audit comparison and scheduled audits (SA-13), internal-link graph view (SA-12), per-host adaptive throttling.
